title: CosmoMail
brief: You are a recruiter at Northwind. Reply to Jordan, who passed the technical screen and is asking about next steps. Lay out the process and propose scheduling the final panel. Jordan will respond — read carefully and keep the thread moving to a booked slot.
world: Northwind is hiring a Senior Engineer. Jordan Lee passed the technical screen and is waiting to hear about the final panel. The hiring manager is Morgan Hale.

persona.personality: Warm, organized, a little anxious about next steps. Grateful when the process is clear.
persona.motivation: Understand the remaining interview steps and lock a time that does not collide with their current job.
persona.goal: A booked final-panel slot plus a clear picture of who they will meet.
persona.communicationStyle: Friendly, concise candidate email. Asks one or two concrete questions. Signs off 'Jordan'.
knowledge: Wednesday morning can work if Tuesday is impossible
constraints: Do not invent interviewers, rounds, or compensation details
If times are vague, ask for two or three specific options instead of guessing

initialDraft.subject: Re: Next steps — Senior Engineer interview

assistant.systemPromptExtra: Coach the learner toward clear, candidate-friendly scheduling communication with concrete options and next steps.
assistant.initialMessage: Want help laying out the next steps and proposing times?

rubricHints.notes: Reward: warm confirmation of passing the screen, a clear outline of remaining steps, concrete scheduling options, and a prompt, professional follow-through that lands a booked time.
